Vital Reports' AI features (dashboard summaries, future report-builder assistance) call out to an external LLM. This tab is where you choose which one.

  1. In Setup → Named Credentials, create a Named Credential (e.g. named Anthropic) pointing at the provider — for Anthropic, URL https://api.anthropic.com, custom header x-api-key carrying your API key. The key never leaves Setup.
  2. Back here, click New Provider: name it, pick the model (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6), paste the Named Credential name, mark it Active and Default.
  3. Click the plug icon to Test Connection — a tiny 1-token probe. Green = working; red = check the Named Credential or model name.

Only one provider should carry the Default flag at a time — the app uses that record. Marking a new one default automatically clears the flag on the old one.
